post: Looking for an ongoing maintenance developer for our internal sales dashboard (Next.js front end, a small Node API, Postgres). Nothing glamorous: bug fixes, a couple of new charts per month, keeping dependencies from rotting, and answering the occasional "why is this number wrong" question from the sales team. I'd estimate 12-15 hours a month. Budget is $900 per month, paid on the 1st, and we can do a 3 month trial and then go quarterly if it works out. Everything is remote, we meet on a video call every other Thursday for 30 minutes. Code is in a private repo, you get access on day one. If you have worked with Recharts or similar, mention it.

gold.why: Monthly retainer of $900 for about 15 hours is roughly $60/hour, well above the floor and the project minimum, remote, and the lead is cheap.

post: Hi! I run a small yoga studio and our booking is a mess of DMs and a spreadsheet. I want a simple site where people can see the class schedule, book a spot, and get a confirmation by email, plus a page where I can add or cancel classes myself. Maybe also take payment but that can be phase two. I have a logo and photos ready. Budget is about two grand, give or take, and I would like it live in six to eight weeks. Totally fine to do everything over Zoom, I am not picky. Thanks!

gold.why: 'Two grand' means about US$2,000 for a booking flow with an admin page, which fits his stack and covers the floor with room, and the $35 lead is small against it.

post: We are a family-owned HVAC company in the Denver area and need a customer portal where clients can see their service history, request a visit and pay invoices online. We also want a simple admin screen for dispatchers. Budget is $4,000 to $5,000. The developer must be local to Denver because we want you to come by the office a few times to sit with the dispatchers and watch how they work, maybe once a month at first. The rest of the work can be remote. We have been burned by overseas freelancers before so being nearby is a hard requirement for us.

gold.why: 'Must be local to Denver' with recurring office visits is a physical-presence requirement, so onsite is true even though most work is remote; the budget is fine but the hard no wins.

post: I need a script that collects product names, prices and stock status from about 40 pages of a public online hardware store. No login or account is needed, anyone can open these pages in a browser, and I have checked that the site has no rule against automated reading of public listings. I want the data written to a Google Sheet once a day and a small alert if a price drops by more than 10 percent. Python or Node is fine, you choose. Fixed price $800. I would like a short README so my assistant can restart it if it stops. Please tell me in your proposal how you would handle the site changing its layout.

gold.why: Scraping public pages with no login is not tos_grey under the guide; $800 fixed for a small scheduled script plus a Sheets and alert integration clears the project minimum and floor rate with room.

post: Hey, I have an idea for a marketplace app where local gardeners list their services and homeowners book them. I need an MVP with sign up, listings, search, messaging, booking and reviews. I can offer you $150 fixed to get started, paid when you deliver the first working version, plus 10% of all revenue the platform makes for the first two years once we start charging. I think this will be big and you would be getting in early. I can send a rough list of features, nothing fancy, just something like a lean Airbnb for gardens. Looking for someone who believes in the idea.

gold.why: The revenue share is on top of a guaranteed fixed fee, so by the guide it is not payment only on success and no hard no is recorded; SKIP because $150 is far below the $550 minimum for a full marketplace MVP (it is also a clone_big_app flag).

post:
Project: customer feedback portal for our SaaS product. Users log in, submit feature requests, vote on others, and our team marks items as planned, in progress or shipped. We also need an admin view with filters and CSV export, and Slack notifications on new requests. Stack is open but we lean toward React and Postgres. Timeline is about six weeks and we have a budget of $3,000 for the full build, with milestone payments. We have received about thirty applications so far and want to hear from people who have shipped something similar. Please include a short note about how you would structure the voting logic and permissions. Thank you for your time and I look forward to reading the proposals.

P.S. To shortlist fairly, every finalist will build a small working prototype of the login and voting screen on our staging server, around 3 to 4 hours of work. It is unpaid, but the winner gets the full project.

gold.why: The deal-breaker sits in the P.S.: a 3 to 4 hour unpaid prototype before selection is unpaid_work (over about 1 hour), so SKIP despite the good $3,000 budget.

post: Need a website for my consulting business. I do leadership coaching for mid-level managers. Not sure yet what I need exactly, maybe a few pages about me, maybe a blog, maybe a way to book calls, maybe a course later? A friend said I should look at something modern. I do not have a budget in mind, I would like to hear what people suggest and what it costs. Open to talking whenever. I do not have logo or branding finished yet but I can work on it.

gold.why: No budget and the scope is unclear (vague_scope), with a $22 lead; nothing rules it out, so it is a CLOSE rather than PAY or SKIP.

post: We are a small dental practice and want a new 5 page website with a CMS so the office manager can update hours, staff bios and a news section herself. We would also like patients to request appointments online (just a form that emails the front desk is OK for now). Our budget is $500 to $700, we know it may not be enough for everything so tell us what you can do for that. Nothing urgent, we would like to launch before the end of next quarter. Everything can be done by video call, we only need the site.

gold.why: Remote and in stack, but the range straddles the $550 minimum and a CMS plus appointment form may need more hours than $500-700 pays at $25/hour, while a $45 lead is large relative to that job.

post: We run a small skincare shop on Shopify and want our theme customised. Specifically, edit the Liquid templates for the product page (add a "build your own bundle" block with a live price), change the cart drawer, and add a metafield-driven ingredients tab. We have a theme already, you would work in a duplicate of it. $1,500 fixed, about two weeks. If you have done bundle builders before please show an example. We pay through the platform on completion of each milestone.

gold.why: Editing Shopify Liquid themes is on his does-not-build list (out_of_stack), so SKIP even though $1,500 is a decent budget.

post: 我們是台中一家有兩間分店的火鍋店，想做一個 LINE 訂位機器人。客人在 LINE 官方帳號點選分店、日期、人數和時段，系統確認還有位子後自動回覆訂位成功，前一天再提醒一次。店長需要一個簡單的後台看當天訂位、可以手動關掉某個時段。不用做金流。預算大概 3.5 萬到 4.5 萬，希望一個半月內可以上線。全程線上討論就可以，不用到店裡。需要的話之後可以簽維護合約。

gold.why: LINE 訂位機器人加簡易後台正是他的專長，預算 NT$35,000 到 45,000 高於最低接案門檻 NT$18,000，可全程遠端，線索費 NT$200 相對很小。

post: 想請人幫忙處理我們幾間民宿在 Google 地圖上的評價。需求是：寫一批像真人的五星評論（每間大約 30 則，內容要有差異），用不同的帳號和不同的 IP 分批貼上去，避免被平台判定是同一個人。最好也能幫忙把幾則負評檢舉到下架。我們預算 2.5 萬，先做一間，做得好再給其他間。時間大概一週內，可以遠端，用 Telegram 聯絡比較快。

gold.why: 偽造五星評論、用多帳號與不同 IP 規避平台偵測屬於 tos_grey（假評論加規避平台規則），任何預算都不接；另有移到 Telegram 的 off_platform 旗標。

post: 公司是做機車零件批發的，員工八個人，目前進貨、庫存跟出貨都在 Excel 上，常常對不起來。想找人幫忙做一套小型的進銷存系統，有沒有人可以先跟我們聊聊需要哪些功能？目前還不確定要做到多完整，可能先做庫存跟出貨，之後再看要不要加報表跟客戶管理。預算還沒抓，想先聽聽報價範圍再決定，也想知道大概要做多久。謝謝。

gold.why: 沒有寫預算、範圍也還沒定（vague_scope），但內容是他能做的小型內部工具，沒有任何硬性不接項目，所以是 CLOSE 而不是 SKIP。
